programme.title: Nakalimutan Ko Nang Kalimutan Ka
programme.desc: Director and writer Fifth Solomon (Ex-PBB Housemate) tells a romantic comedy story on how to move on with heartaches and painful memories. A tale full of tears and laughter as Jaz Cruz (Alex Gonzaga) deals with different stages of moving on.

programme.title: Pak! Pak! My Dr. Kwak
programme.desc: An angel is sent to Earth to convince a conman healer to change his way, only to have the conman take advantage of his angelic healing powers. The conman's road to salvation lies in reconciling with one his victims, and the angel has to find a way to get them together.

programme.title: My Perfect You
programme.desc: Burn, a man who’s down in the dumps, and Abi, the girl who helps him see the light again. Will they find the perfect love for them or will they have to fave heartbreak again?

programme.title: Sukob
programme.desc: A Filipino couple working overseas return to their hometown to get married; however, a deadly curse follows the couple, based on the superstition that marriage should not take place within a year of the death of an immediate relative.

programme.title: Maybe This Time
programme.desc: \"Steph Asuncion and Tonio Bugayong were once in love. Back then, she was a young girl who wanted a simple life and he was older, more ambitious than she was. Tonio was a small town guy who wants to board a ship to provide for his family’s furniture business. Sarah was a Manila girl who spends the summer in the province for community service. What might have been a sweet relationship ended sourly when Tonio left without saying goodbye. Steph was heartbroken and it taught her to dream bigger to be worthy of love. Will their paths cross again? Will they overcome the pains of the past to give love a second chance? This is a story between two people who will be reminded about the importance of being true to one’s self in order for true love to happen.\".

programme.title: Changing Partners
programme.desc: It tells the story of Alex and Cris which despite their 15-year age gap, are celebrating their first anniversary of living with each other.
